appearances.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
appearances.summary: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More

appearances.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
appearances.headline: claude-mem adds persistent memory to agents
appearances.newly_possible: An agent can now carry compressed context from past sessions into new ones across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Copilot and more.
appearances.why: Cross-session memory is the gap between one-off prompts and agents that accumulate project knowledge.
appearances.limits: Compression quality and what context survives are not quantified here.

appearances.read: Agents can now keep what they learned in one session and bring it into the next, across several coding tools.
